# Back memory and native input retirement gates

This is a source audit. It changes no repository file and runs no Cargo command.
The source record is HEAD `f9d2b99563ae398f56cb8455317ce1e4832a94b1` plus the current working source hashes in
[source-sha256.json](source-sha256.json). The record verifies all 125 remaining
Back files against custody109. The recovery archive is unchanged.

## Exact next files

| Old whole file | Replacement gate | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `package/installed/snapshot/memory.rs` | Existing image capacity owners; aba0 shared admitted metadata; f85 tight member replacement; da52 shared source map | Eligible after the focused gates pass. 240 production lines. |
| `package/installed/snapshot/memory/tests.rs` | All seven assertion rows in [memory-map.json](memory-map.json) | Eligible with its owner. Test-only; zero production lines. |

The standalone counter reports 20 helper lines in memory/tests.rs and 66 in
model/tests/stream.rs. These paths are test-only through their parent module.
Do not count those helpers as production reduction.

## Memory ownership

PackageBundleV1::allocated_bytes counts the actual immutable image buffers.
Packages::new reserves that image before native body planning. PackageCall and
PreparedDefinition share that image and reservation. DefinitionAdmission keeps
resolved metadata, source requests and their charge under the same private Arc.
Instance keeps native extension Arc nodes and moves its charged spec into the
Data row returned by admission. It does not deep-clone a spec under a shared
reservation. The Run successor borrows the admitted source map.

Host active membership retains only key/generation/lifecycle and actual buffer
charges. Its replacement test holds a real guest and enough pressure that a
second image cannot fit. It stops and restarts the same key, joins the old
member, and then admits the replacement under that same pressure. It checks
generation, new lifecycle, publication, the store lease, both evaluation permits,
and full input/output release. It adds no consuming snapshot API.

The complete 15-method map and seven old tests are in memory-map.json. Current
proof uses defined entry storage and owned String/Vec capacities. It does not
claim allocator internals, all Data decode allocations, or all native planner
heap. The old guessed B-tree node size is removed.

Old admission_stops_at_capacity constructs a valid first export and an invalid
later unused export. Its eager compilation order does not carry into native
demand planning. Preserve capacity rejection before selected image/body work,
metadata charge, no mutation, and release. Do not compile unused exports to make
that old error precedence reappear. Immutable definitions also have no old
mutable revision Update operation. The tight same-key lifecycle replacement is
the current consuming boundary. Neither change removes a resource check.

## Remaining native input gates

model/input.rs and model/operation.rs are already retired. The remaining whole
model/operation/tests.rs contains ten test cases. Its exact map is in
[model-input-map.json](model-input-map.json). Full0264 closes the body-port and
retained nested-call metadata gap. It does not by itself close this whole test
file. The smallest additions use the existing native Definition Fixture:

1. Extend sql_body_scope with the old five denied SQL forms, including unused
   CTEs, output_result before output binding, private port names and table
   functions. Require the native Invalid/nonretryable cause.
2. Reuse Session::set_timeout, await its existing control.expired event, then
   require deadline rejection before a native child starts. Prove parent reuse
   and complete pool/permit release. No new clock or timing owner.
3. Hold actual remaining shared input capacity around an admitted SQL call.
   Require typed Busy, no output/child publication or Data mutation. Release
   pressure and execute that same admission successfully. Reuse existing pool
   and native gate fixtures. The old one-byte-pressure failure depended on
   reserving the entire extraction maximum; current prepare_input must keep its
   valid remaining-capacity behavior.
4. Port the old four-input permutation matrix into actual PackageExec. Compare
   per-name batches/revision/coverage, declared return order, distinct direct
   source revisions and complete capture metadata. Remove the unrelated alias
   only in the third form. Include exact quoted/unquoted uppercase handling.
   Keep the admitted metadata size stable and prove full release.

Also extend the existing native source-elision case with the old exact revision
equality: selected value7 and unused-CTE constant7 have equal input revisions at
the same cut; false/empty input differs. Declared-source coverage alone does not
prove this content-hash equality.

These are proof gaps in current native tests. This audit finds no required new
production owner for them. A failing exact test can identify a real remaining
implementation gap; do not weaken the assertion or restore the old executor.

The aggregate-output-before-reference assertion is already stronger in

Data stays unchanged, and all configured capacity returns. Source-elision,
forward aliases, nested retention, exact external revision/coverage and native

receipt owner; they do not substitute for actual PackageExec proof.
